title: About
text:
InertialRange Labs AB is an AI engineering and data-platform consulting practice run by Farrukh Nauman, PhD, registered in Sweden (Aktiebolag) and based in Linköping.
I work as an AI engineer and principal consultant: I design and ship agentic systems — Text-to-SQL, coding agents, evaluation harnesses, tool contracts — against real schemas and real data on enterprise platforms (BigQuery, Snowflake, Databricks, Spark, Snowpark, SQL databases). When an engagement needs it, I also take interim / fractional leadership of data and AI teams. Across both, the constant is delivery: enforced retrieval, deterministic guardrails, result-level evaluation, and the test discipline that makes agents trustworthy in production.

title: About
text:
Founder
Since August 2025 I’ve been consulting through InertialRange Labs AB. My current engagement (since November 2026) is as an AI engineer: I build AI agents on top of an analytics stack on Google Cloud (BigQuery), and I work on the evaluations and tracing used to improve them.
Before that I served as interim team lead for Data Science & Advanced Analytics (Sep 2025 – Jun 2026) at a global industrial manufacturer, leading a 4–7 person team across telemetry analytics, ML, and GenAI automation — owning the roadmap, stakeholder steering, and technical direction.
Before InertialRange, I held AI researcher and consultant roles at RISE Research Institutes of Sweden (Jul 2021 – Aug 2025), where I led a Vinnova-funded applied AI project on circular fashion (project lead, ~9M SEK) and contributed as AI lead to the EU CISUTAC initiative (~2M SEK). Earlier, I held research positions at Chalmers University of Technology and the Niels Bohr Institute, and completed a PhD in Physics and Astronomy at the University of Rochester.
For my detailed profile, writing, and CV, see fnauman.com, and selected work for worked case studies.

title: About
text:
Why this company exists
Most AI and data-platform initiatives fail for predictable reasons: weak validation, underestimated data readiness, and a gap between prototypes and production. InertialRange exists to remove those failure modes with systematic evaluation, clear scope, and delivery-oriented execution.
Running my own company also lets me choose the right engagements — the ones where I can take real ownership and deliver measurable outcomes.

title: Offers
text: Each offer has a defined result and a contract type. Two are fixed price, one is a monthly retainer, and one is time-based. If you are not sure which one fits, the table below maps common situations to an offer.

title: Offers
text:
The offers


1 · Agent Reliability Audit
Fixed price · about 2 weeks
For: teams with an agent or LLM feature in pilot or production who cannot say how often it is right.
What I do: build an evaluation set from your real questions and logs, score the current system on the results it returns, and read the traces to classify why it fails.
You get: the eval suite in your repository, a baseline accuracy figure with its uncertainty, a failure breakdown, and a ranked list of fixes.


2 · Agent Build Sprint
Fixed price · 4 to 6 weeks
For: teams that know which agent they want — an analytics agent, Text-to-SQL over the warehouse, a coding-agent workflow for a migration — and need it built and proven.
What I do: agree the acceptance test in week one (an eval set and a pass mark), then build to it: grounding, guardrails, tool contracts, evaluation.
You get: a working agent in your environment, its results against the agreed pass mark, and a handoff plan for production.


3 · Reliability Retainer
Monthly fee · a fixed number of days per month
For: teams with agents already in use, where models, prompts, and data keep changing.
What I do: re-run the eval suite when something changes, review agent changes before they ship, extend the suite as new failures show up, and answer questions as they come.
You get: a monthly regression report, reviewed changes, and a senior engineer who already knows your system.


4 · Embedded AI Engineering
Hourly or daily rate · typically three months or more
For: larger builds, or teams that need a senior engineer or an interim lead inside the team.
What I do: join your team and deliver alongside it: agents, data-platform work, migrations with coding agents. When needed I lead the team as well, most recently a 4–7 person data science and analytics team.
You get: senior capacity under your own planning, contracted directly or through your consultant broker.

Legal entity: InertialRange Labs AB (Swedish Aktiebolag) — invoicing in SEK or EUR.
